children: Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 17, 2026) - Happy Belly Food Group Inc.

(OTCQB: HBFGF) ("Happy Belly" or the "Company"), a leader in acquiring and scaling emerging food brands, is pleased to announce that it has secured a real estate location in the Elgin Street area of Ottawa, Ontario, for an existing multi-unit, multi-branded franchisee. The planned restaurant will further expand Heal Wellness ("
") in the nation's capital. Heal is a quick-service restaurant ("
") brand specializing in fresh smoothie bowls, açaí bowls, and smoothies.
To view an enhanced version of this graphic, please visit:

"Securing this location in Ottawa's Elgin Street area represents another step forward in Heal's Ontario expansion and the continued growth of our relationships with existing franchisees," said Sean Black, Chief Executive Officer of Happy Belly. "This franchisee already owns and operates a Heal Wellness restaurant in Ottawa, along with two Via Cibo restaurants in the Ottawa region. Their decision to expand with another Heal demonstrates their confidence in our brands and their commitment to growing alongside Happy Belly."

Elgin Street is an established downtown dining and shopping destination, adjoining Ottawa's Golden Triangle neighbourhood and situated near the Rideau Canal. Its mix of restaurants, independent businesses and surrounding residential streets creates an appealing setting for Heal's fresh smoothie bowls, açaí bowls and smoothies. The planned location will offer a convenient option for residents, people working downtown and visitors seeking clean fresh food that complements a busy and active lifestyle.
To view an enhanced version of this graphic, please visit:

"Our growth is strengthened when operators who know our brands firsthand choose to reinvest across our portfolio," added Sean Black. "With an existing Heal and two Via Cibo restaurants in the Ottawa region, this franchisee brings local market knowledge and experience operating multiple Happy Belly brands. Their continued investment makes them a strong supporter of our portfolio and reinforces the value of building lasting franchisee relationships. We look forward to working together to bring another Heal to Ottawa."

Heal Wellness continues to expand rapidly across Canada and into the United States, strengthening its position as a leading açaí and smoothie bowl brand and a key driver of growth within Happy Belly's broader portfolio of emerging restaurant brands. With

units in its development pipeline under signed development agreements, Heal has a substantial foundation for continued, predictable expansion. We remain focused on translating this development pipeline into operating restaurants and creating long-term value for our shareholders.

Heal Wellness was founded with a passion and mission to provide quick, fresh wellness foods that support a busy and active lifestyle. We currently offer a diverse range of smoothie bowls and smoothies. We take pride in meticulously selecting every superfood ingredient on our menu to fuel the body, including acai smoothie bowls, smoothies, and super-seed grain bowls. Our smoothie bowls are crafted with real fruit and enriched with superfoods like acai, pitaya, goji berries, chia seeds, and more.
(OTCQB: HBFGF) ("Happy Belly" or the "Company") is a leader in acquiring and scaling emerging food brands across Canada.
